text.card: A star about 16 parsecs away, 1.5 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.5 solar radii and 1.25 solar masses (FLAME) and 6,319 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Tau Boötis
quotes.card: Tau Boötis, Latinised from τ Boötis and formally named Tepiamenit, is a wide binary star system in the northern constellation of Boötes.
quotes.introduction: This system is visible to the naked eye at a point of light with a combined apparent visual magnitude of 4.50.
